# ENGINE 1 — CANVAS 05 / DUAL CRM SYNC
**PostgreSQL is source of truth.** Install the separate Canvas 05 SQL migration, assign provider-specific Header Auth credentials, verify real owner IDs and CRM custom fields, then test before enabling schedules.
Independent HubSpot and GHL jobs. No secrets or actual location IDs in JSON.
**Import defaults: all schedules disabled, all database flags OFF.**

# HUBSPOT
Identity first: saved ID → GET, else exact email/phone search. Block conflicts. Create via unique `engine1_contact_id` batch upsert, update by record ID. Never clear lifecycle stage.
Required custom properties listed in setup. HTTP credential = HubSpot private app bearer token.

# GOHIGHLEVEL
Saved ID → GET, else duplicate lookups by email and phone; do not merge split identities. Existing: PUT, new: POST /contacts/upsert with `createNewIfDuplicateAllowed:false`. Preserve tags.
Version: `2021-07-28`. Credential must belong to the correct GHL sub-account and have contact read/write scopes.

# RECONCILIATION & FAILURE SAFETY
Every 2m: queue changed fields promptly; periodic read-back detects owner drift. Every 5m: expired CRM HTTP sends become UNKNOWN, not blind retries. Provider failures are recorded by PostgreSQL with Canvas 06 incidents.
Schedules intentionally disabled until credentials, custom fields, and SQL migration are configured.
